sens_en: to pick, to take off, to extract
origine_fr: La main 扌 et 啇, qui donnait le son mais se lit dì. Au départ, 摘 veut dire « cueillir les fruits d'un arbre ». De là « enlever, extraire ».
origine_en: The hand 扌 with 啇, which gave the sound but is read dì. At first, 摘 meant “to pick fruit from a tree”. Hence “to take off, to extract”.
